name: Martin Zumsande
cooked: Many of the IPv6 connections are network-specific connections that are attempted on average every 5 minutes (EXTRA_NETWORK_PEER_INTERVAL): The node views IPv6 as reachable and therefore tries in vain every 5 minutes to diversify its networks by adding an additional IPv6 full outbound. I don’t think this is a huge problem because these attempts fail immediately and shouldn’t take up meaningful resources, but it would be nice if we could detect automatically if IPv6 is reachable.
topic_title: Outbound connection success rates of a Bitcoin node
